主要内容: SAP SE (SAP) and Callidus Software Inc. issued a joint press release announcing the entry into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger. The merger involves the Company, SAP America, Inc., and Emerson One Acquisition Corp. Under the terms of the agreement, holders of the Company’s common stock will receive $36.00 per share in cash for their shares. The transaction is subject to the satisfaction of conditions specified in the Merger Agreement. The press release includes a cautionary statement regarding forward-looking statements, highlighting risks such as regulatory reviews, the ability to complete the transaction, and the failure to achieve anticipated synergies. The merger is expected to result in combined operations, products, and services, with the Company’s role within SAP post-transaction being a key consideration. The press release is incorporated by reference and includes details from SAP’s SEC filings, including its Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2016.
